caption:
Morning dhikr: start your day by remembering Allah.

Allah calls the believers to remember Him much and to glorify Him morning and evening. Before the emails and the news, give Him the first minutes of your day.

— Surah Al-Ahzaab 33:41-42

Which words of remembrance will you begin with today?

#quran #dhikr #morningdhikr #remembrance
alt_text: O you who believe, remember Allah much; and glorify Him morning and evening — Surah Al-Ahzaab 33:41-42
